mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, status, reason, original_file_name, file_sha256, file_content, precheck_json, row_version, created_by, created_at, published_at FROM roster_import_batch WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE roster_import_batch SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'PRECHECKED'
